crossRefs.note: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands…
They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom…
For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly…
For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.
I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.
A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an…
All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good, and the good of their children…
For the promise is to you, and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call…

translations.web: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
translations.bsb: The righteous man walks with integrity; blessed are his children after him.
translations.kjv: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after
